query:
SELECT pbq.id, pbq.quoted_amount, pbq.labor_cost, pbq.parts_cost, pbq.status, pbq.components_json, pbq.itemized_breakdown, pb.business_name
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
LEFT JOIN marketplace_profiles pb ON pb.id = pbq.panel_beater_id
WHERE pbq.claim_id = '6240003'
ORDER BY pbq.id;
